title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila plans a beach outing to celebrate Pallavan's success and strengthen their bond after the conflict. Later, the family enjoys a refreshing time together at the beach.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar and Mathi push Lakshmi to manage the family after their secret movie outing comes to light. Lakshmi spins clever stories to escape Thangaraj's relentless questioning.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 78: Letters at a Cost
description: Ansar and Vasan go head-to-head in the captaincy task. Meanwhile, Anbin Kural takes an emotional turn as housemates compete for a chance to receive the letters from their families.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya stays in Rajangam's parking area as the lawyer informs Chithra of her departure. Meanwhile, Tamizhselvi rejects Rajangam's plea to forgive them and return home.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri insists on practising dance with Karthik while he rehearses with Priya, revealing her jealousy. Later, Priya questions Karthik about his bond with Kasthuri.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani gets ready for the baby shower while Rajeshwari taunts her and blocks Kaveri and Sarasu at the entrance. Anbu immediately objects and stands up for them.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: At Abhi and Shanmugam's reception, Azhagappan humiliates Kandhasamy's family by seating them in the back row. He also blocks Kandhasamy from the stage in favor of VIPs.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil stays with Meena at Ravi's house after fighting with Pandian. Meanwhile, Raji worries about Muthuvel's health, and Saravanan consoles a grieving Anjali who lost her father.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi remains firm despite Sudha's plea after the insult towards Ravi. Rohini, Shruthi, and Meena approach Parvathy, hoping to establish their event business at her house.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna schemes with Divakar to ensure Vetri receives a harsh punishment from the court. Meanwhile, Abinaya and Prabhakaran investigate Sathish and uncover a vital clue.

title: Thaai Maaman
episodeTitle: Azhagar Steps in to Help Poongodi
description: Poongodi worries over Senthamizh's disappearance as Azhagar reveals Thennavan's love for her. Learning of Senthamizh's elopement, Azhagar joins Poongodi to find her.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Rishi blocks Ilamathi and Nalini from collecting Viji's blood for the DNA test. However, Ilamathi cleverly tricks him into driving out and gets the sample discreetly.
